jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
At Podium, we bring AI Employees to local businesses that turn every conversation into revenue. Trusted by 60,000+ businesses across Auto, Home Services, and Aesthetics, Podium captures and converts leads 24/7, driving both new business and repeat customers.

In under 24 months, we crossed $100M in AI Agent ARR, scaling 300% year-over-year. During this time, we’ve deployed 10,000 AI employees to empower real business outcomes for our customers. Podium is building what we believe will be the most impactful AI employee ecosystem for local business.

Podium has been recognized as the Best AI Implementation by Inc. Magazine, highlighted by OpenAI for building revenue-driving AI Agents, and awarded the #1 AI Agent for Business Operations by G2.

Our growth is fueled by hiring exceptional people, holding them to high standards, and creating opportunities for them to grow and make an impact. Our operating principles guide daily behavior and ensure we hire people who will thrive at Podium. If you're hungry for growth, aligned to our operating principles, and ready to get to work, you won't find a better place to learn and accelerate your career.

The Chief of Staff, Customer & Revenue Operations, will report to and partner with the COO, focusing on our post-sales performance and strategy, internal business systems, and revenue operations. You’ll work closely with cross-functional leaders to drive execution, alignment, and strategy across our most critical post-sales, customer, and internal operations initiatives.

This candidate will help operate the Customer & Revenue Operations (C&RO) organization and identify and lead high-impact initiatives. It is critical that the Chief of Staff is aligned with our operating principles . This individual must be able to work in a fast-changing, ambiguous environment. The Chief of Staff will amplify the effectiveness of the COO and the rest of the (C&RO) leadership team.

What you will be doing:

- Work directly with the COO and leadership to define CX & RevOps priorities, including strategic planning and goal setting based on company-wide objectives

- Partner closely with the COO and cross-functional leaders to support C&RO organization, driving strategic alignment and execution on top initiatives

- Support C&RO organization in prioritizing initiatives, managing team operating cadences, and ensuring follow-through on key decisions and action items

- Provide leverage to COO by representing his decisions/thinking/voice to all levels of C&RO org as well as key cross-functional leaders

- Translate high-level strategic decisions into actionable plans with associated ownership, prioritization, and timelines, formally and informally. Form an independent point of view on what is required to achieve our vision. Work with the leadership team to understand potential gaps, define plans to address them, and ensure we execute on those plans

- Shape and manage the objectives and operating cadence of leadership team meetings–facilitating discussions on the right topics and managing follow-up on action items

- Lead and organize content creation for key documents or meetings related to the C&RO organization (e.g., All Hands, Quarterly/Monthly/Weekly Business Reviews, Scorecards, etc.)

- At times may be asked to step in and act as a leader in specific areas if there are gaps

- Identify opportunities in the C&RO organization and lead high-impact strategic projects

What you should have:

The ideal candidate is someone with 3-7+ years of total experience, including experience in either business consulting (Bain, McKinsey, etc.), or as part of an internal strategy and/or operations team.

- Alignment with our operating principles

- Located or open to relocation to work onsite at our headquarters in Lehi, Utah

- MBA, Bachelor's or equivalent experience

- Experience working with CX, RevOps, and Corporate Strategy teams

- Experience working in the SaaS or Technology industry is a plus, especially vertical and/or SMB SaaS

- Ability to be a thought partner to the COO/CX/RevOps leaders by structuring and solving complex problems

- Ability to communicate clearly and directly to drive accountability and action

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Excellent project management skills

- Experience working with significant change and ambiguity

- Ability to multitask and prioritize in a rapidly changing environment with competing priorities

- Willingness to roll up sleeves to directly solve difficult problems

- Systems thinking and the ability to create new structures or processes

- Pragmatic and logical in thinking and decision-making

- Trustworthiness to handle confidential information with integrity

BENEFITS

- Open and transparent culture

- Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage

- Paid parental leave

- Fertility benefits

- Generous vacation time, plus three 4-day summer holiday weekends

- Excellent medical, dental, and vision benefits

- 401k Plan

- Bi-annual swag drops with cool Podium gear and apparel

- A stellar HQ (Utah) gym with local professional coaches and classes offered

- Onsite HQ (Utah) child care center, subsidized for employees

Podium is an equal opportunity employer. Podium provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, or veteran status.

About the Role

We are transforming the way Aesthetic businesses operate with an AI workforce, and we're hiring the Director who will run marketing demand generation end to end. Think of this as the CMO of a sub-vertical: you own the monthly revenue, pipeline, and efficiency numbers the business is counting on. You own the strategy and channel execution to get there.

This is a builder and operator role: you'll roll up your sleeves, drive critical projects, lean in deeply with a team of direct and indirect reports, and IC where needed to get the job done. You're deeply performance and demand focused.

The right person is highly biased towards action, hungry to drive impact, exercises extreme ownership, thrives at a startup pace, and can set a vision that inspires the team. You're a heavy AI user, passionate about building a marketing engine at the bleeding edge of what's possible.

This role is required to be in office 5 days per week at our Lehi HQ.

What You'll Own

- Set an integrated Aesthetics marketing strategy that delivers on demand targets and rallies the team. Set the vision, set the pace, and hold the org to it.

- Hold full accountability for marketing's monthly revenue, pipeline, and efficiency targets, plus the levers underneath them: channel mix, budget allocation, execution, comms calendar, and demand content. You own the number and how it gets hit.

- Track pacing and pipeline against targets, and proactively lead the team in building and executing on gap plans the moment funnel targets slip.

- Lead, coach and raise the ceiling for a lean team of direct reports owning trade show/events, partner marketing, webinars, third-party media, lifecycle and content marketing channels.

- Proactively collaborate with a team of indirect reports (centralized marketing subject matter experts) across digital channels, AEO/SEO, and web, to execute on the highest impact strategies in your vertical.

- Rigorously measure the efficacy of tactics/channels/funnel and continuously optimize via experimentation. Align marketing portfolio bets to maximize impact.

- Manage the vertical budget, spending within profitability constraints, surfacing opportunities. Drive AOP planning prep and recommendations.

- Regularly report on marketing performance and strategy to leadership / exec team.

- Set the standard for AI-first marketing in tooling, planning, and agent building, deploying AI workflows that transform impact.

- Work closely with marketing leadership across other verticals (auto, aesthetics) and partnering functions (design, product marketing) to prep for launches, align on resourcing and positioning. Align with Sales, CS, Product, Finance, and Revenue Operations leaders on goals and priorities.

Candidate Profile

Must Haves

- Successful track record of leading an integrated, demand generation strategy/function or channel group with accountability to a revenue number, a budget, and ROI.

- Hands-on depth across relevant marketing channels like trade shows, field or partner marketing, lifecycle, webinars, content marketing, digital, and ABM. You've personally run a collection of channels at similar scale.

- Extreme ownership and bias to action. You move fast without waiting for consensus, and you're comfortable building a strategy out of ambiguity and high change.

- Critical thinker and analytically rigorous. You make data informed decisions using full funnel metrics and know what inputs are most important to drive to a decision.

- Highly performance focused and ROI minded. Understands the right balance of investment into higher funnel initiatives and the limitations of various attribution methods.

- Excellent communicator. Clear, decisive, and collaborative.

- Sets a high bar for the team and provides the coaching, vision and accountability to get there.

- Excellent project management skills. Can drive action and alignment.

- Customer first. Draws on a deep understanding of the customer, industry and Podium value.

- Uses AI heavily, building workflows and agents. Can show what you've built.

- A strong cross-functional partner. Builds trust and alignment across the org.

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience marketing to SMBs / local businesses or marketing an AI product.

- Familiarity with the Aesthetics industry and their buying behavior.

Not a Fit If

- You need a big team, a big agency, or a big budget to operate.

- You want to run strategy and hand execution to someone else. You own both.

About the Role

We are transforming the way Home Services businesses operate with an AI workforce, and we're hiring the Director who will run marketing demand generation end to end. Think of this as the CMO of a sub-vertical: you own the monthly revenue, pipeline, and efficiency numbers the business is counting on. You own the strategy and channel execution to get there.

This is a builder and operator role: you'll roll up your sleeves, drive critical projects, lean in deeply with a team of direct and indirect reports, and IC where needed to get the job done. You're deeply performance and demand focused.

The right person is highly biased towards action, hungry to drive impact, exercises extreme ownership, thrives at a startup pace, and can set a vision that inspires the team. You're a heavy AI user, passionate about building a marketing engine at the bleeding edge of what's possible.

This role is required to be in office 5 days per week at our Lehi HQ.

What You'll Own

- Set an integrated Home Services marketing strategy that delivers on demand targets and rallies the team. Set the vision, set the pace, and hold the org to it.

- Hold full accountability for marketing's monthly revenue, pipeline, and efficiency targets, plus the levers underneath them: channel mix, budget allocation, execution, comms calendar, and demand content. You own the number and how it gets hit.

- Track pacing and pipeline against targets, and proactively lead the team in building and executing on gap plans the moment funnel targets slip.

- Lead, coach and raise the ceiling for a lean team of direct reports owning trade show/events, partner marketing, webinars, third-party media, lifecycle and content marketing channels.

- Proactively collaborate with a team of indirect reports (centralized marketing subject matter experts) across digital channels, AEO/SEO, and web, to execute on the highest impact strategies in your vertical.

- Rigorously measure the efficacy of tactics/channels/funnel and continuously optimize via experimentation. Align marketing portfolio bets to maximize impact.

- Manage the vertical budget, spending within profitability constraints, surfacing opportunities. Drive AOP planning prep and recommendations.

- Regularly report on marketing performance and strategy to leadership / exec team.

- Set the standard for AI-first marketing in tooling, planning, and agent building, deploying AI workflows that transform impact.

- Work closely with marketing leadership across other verticals (auto, aesthetics) and partnering functions (design, product marketing) to prep for launches, align on resourcing and positioning. Align with Sales, CS, Product, Finance, and Revenue Operations leaders on goals and priorities.

Candidate Profile

Must Haves

- Successful track record of leading an integrated, demand generation strategy/function or channel group with accountability to a revenue number, a budget, and ROI.

- Hands-on depth across relevant marketing channels like trade shows, field or partner marketing, lifecycle, webinars, content marketing, digital, and ABM. You've personally run a collection of channels at similar scale.

- Extreme ownership and bias to action. You move fast without waiting for consensus, and you're comfortable building a strategy out of ambiguity and high change.

- Critical thinker and analytically rigorous. You make data informed decisions using full funnel metrics and know what inputs are most important to drive to a decision.

- Highly performance focused and ROI minded. Understands the right balance of investment into higher funnel initiatives and the limitations of various attribution methods.

- Excellent communicator. Clear, decisive, and collaborative.

- Sets a high bar for the team and provides the coaching, vision and accountability to get there.

- Excellent project management skills. Can drive action and alignment.

- Customer first. Draws on a deep understanding of the customer, industry and Podium value.

- Uses AI heavily, building workflows and agents. Can show what you've built.

- A strong cross-functional partner. Builds trust and alignment across the org.

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience marketing to SMBs / local businesses or marketing an AI product.

- Familiarity with the home services trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, pest, landscaping, etc.) and their buying behavior.

Not a Fit If

- You need a big team, a big agency, or a big budget to operate.

- You want to run strategy and hand execution to someone else. You own both.

About this opportunity:

As the Manager, Customer Success (SMB) at Podium, you’ll lead a team of Customer Success Managers who each own a high-volume portfolio of 150+ small and medium-sized businesses. You’ll coach and develop your team to deliver outstanding onboarding, drive product adoption, and ensure customers get the full value of our AI-powered platform from onboarding through to renewal.

This is a fast-paced, commercially focused leadership role where you’ll balance people management with operational excellence. You’ll own team performance against retention, adoption and expansion targets, build scalable processes that work across a large book of business, and partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing and Support to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

If you’re someone who enjoys building and developing high-performing teams, thrives in a high-growth environment, and loves helping customers succeed with innovative technology, we’d love to hear from you.

What you will be doing:

- Lead, coach and develop a team of SMB Customer Success Managers, fostering a high-performance culture built on accountability, curiosity and customer-first thinking.

- Own team performance against key metrics including gross and net revenue retention, product adoption, customer health and onboarding time-to-value.

- Run regular 1:1s, pipeline and portfolio reviews, and performance conversations, setting clear goals and supporting each CSM’s growth and career progression.

- Monitor portfolio health across the team, identifying retention risks early and guiding CSMs in building and executing effective save and success plans.

- Oversee the onboarding experience, ensuring cohorts and customer milestones are delivered within target timeframes and set customers up for long-term success.

- Design, refine and scale playbooks, segmentation and processes that let the team manage a high-volume portfolio effectively, including tech-touch and automated engagement.

- Act as an escalation point for at-risk or high-priority customers, building strong relationships with key stakeholders where needed.

- Partner closely with Sales, Support, Product and Marketing to deliver a seamless customer experience, and advocate for customer needs and feedback.

- Forecast renewals and expansion, and report on team performance, trends and insights to senior leadership.

- Ensure accurate customer records, health scores and account activity are maintained within the CRM, and use data to drive decisions.

- Recruit, onboard and train new team members, and keep the team up to date on best practices, new features and AI capabilities.

What you should have:

- 4+ years’ experience in Customer Success, Account Management or Customer Experience within a SaaS or technology business, including 1+ years leading or mentoring a team.

- Experience managing or overseeing a high-volume book of business with ownership of retention, product adoption and customer engagement.

- Proven ability to coach and develop people, with a track record of building motivated, high-performing teams.

- Strong commercial awareness, with experience forecasting renewals, identifying churn risks and driving successful customer outcomes.

- A customer-first mindset with the ability to build trust and influence stakeholders, both internally and across multiple customer accounts.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging customers and senior stakeholders virtually and over the phone.

- Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities across a large portfolio and team.

- A proactive, data-driven, solutions-focused approach and the ability to thrive in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

- Experience using CRM and Customer Success platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot or Gainsight is highly regarded.

- Be a part of a high performing team
